verdict: 95 leads at $5.23 each — strong volume, but attribution is incomplete.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered 95 leads at a cost of $5.23 per lead, with the most recent week producing 41 leads as spend scaled up sharply. That volume gain is real, but cost per lead rose 10% week-over-week alongside the spend increase, signaling early efficiency pressure as budgets grow. Separately, several foundational setup items — including conversion tracking, landing pages, and lead-nurture sequences — remain unfinished, which means the leads being counted today cannot yet be fully verified end-to-end. Work to close those gaps is the current priority, and Phase 1 concludes September 30, at which point we'll have a clear picture of what's working and where to invest next.
